description: 2024 NTD Annual Data - Service Data and Operating Expenses by Mode (Time Series 2.1) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. This dataset details service data and operating expenses, broken out by agency and mode, reported to the National Transit Database for the 2024 report year. NTD Data Tables organize and summarize data from the 2024 National Transit Database in a manner that is more useful for quick reference and summary analysis. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 20 columns, among them City, Census Year, UZA Population, Report Year, Field, Mode. The portal shows 2025-11-06 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
